mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 0.12% is at historically low levels, compressing discount rates and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is at 0.12%.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 235.5 signals high inflation, triggering monetary tightening and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 235.5.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.10% and unemployment rises above 5.5%, the combination signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 0.10 and UNRATE > 5.5, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During recessions defined by unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% and rising, the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5 and rising.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1150 thousand units, it indicates strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1150, SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1150 thousand units and industrial production exceeds 105, the economy is in a strong expansion phase, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1150 and INDPRO > 105, SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of retail sales (RSAFS) at 444926.0 million dollars indicates strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS is at 444926.0 million dollars, SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of industrial expansion (INDPRO > 105), the S&P 500 produces positive forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO > 105, SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances.
